_comment: Seat identities (lane C100). A seat is identified by an SSH public key it signs attestations with (ssh-keygen -Y sign, namespace aaroneous-attestation), and optionally by GitHub logins for formal reviews. Keys are added by PR reviewed by the owner; an empty list means the seat has no verifiable identity yet and its attestations are attested-only. The shared owner/automation login is deliberately not a seat.
